verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships a built-in AI assistant (Command), so it is fair to ask whether users can connect external MCP servers to it, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Command or Books acting as an MCP client. The only MCP mention is a future ('Soon') MCP layer that would let outside AI agents operate Books. That is the server role and unshipped, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
